controls.description: The organization shall document a deployment plan and ensure that appropriate requirements are met prior to deployment.
controls.full_text: The organization shall document a deployment plan and ensure that appropriate requirements are met prior to deployment.

evidence_requirements.name: AI System Deployment Plan
evidence_requirements.description: Deployment plan covering development vs deployment environments, component-level deployment, release criteria (V&V, performance metrics, user testing) and management approvals/sign-offs.

evidence_requirements.name: Pre-Deployment Approval Records
evidence_requirements.description: Approval records confirming pre-deployment requirements are met and impacts to interested parties considered.

controls.title: AI System Operation and Monitoring
controls.description: The organization shall define and document the necessary elements for the ongoing operation of the AI system. At the minimum this should include system and performance monitoring, repairs, updates and support.
controls.full_text: The organization shall define and document the necessary elements for the ongoing operation of the AI system. At the minimum, this should include system and performance monitoring, repairs, updates and support.

evidence_requirements.name: AI Operations Runbook
evidence_requirements.description: Runbook documenting system and performance monitoring (including for continuous-learning systems and concept/data drift), error/failure response, repairs, updates, change control and support arrangements.

evidence_requirements.name: Performance Monitoring Dashboards
evidence_requirements.description: Operational dashboards monitoring AI system technical performance and alignment with interested-party expectations/legal requirements.

evidence_requirements.name: AI-Specific Threat Catalogue
evidence_requirements.description: Catalogue of AI-specific information security threats (data poisoning, model stealing, model inversion) and corresponding monitoring/treatment.

evidence_requirements.name: Support & SLA Records
evidence_requirements.description: Support arrangements (internal/external), SLAs and metrics records for AI system support.

controls.title: AI System Technical Documentation
controls.description: The organization shall determine what AI system technical documentation is needed for each relevant category of interested parties, such as users, partners, supervisory authorities, and provide the technical documentation to them in the appropriate form.
controls.full_text: The organization shall determine what AI system technical documentation is needed for each relevant category of interested parties, such as users, partners, supervisory authorities, and provide the technical documentation to them in the appropriate form.

evidence_requirements.name: AI System Technical Documentation Pack
evidence_requirements.description: Technical documentation covering general description, intended purpose, usage instructions, technical assumptions, technical limitations, monitoring capabilities, design/architecture, development data, data quality assumptions, risk management activities, V&V records, in-operation changes and impact assessments.

evidence_requirements.name: Failure Management Plan
evidence_requirements.description: Plan for managing failures including rollback, feature toggling, update process, customer/user notification and updated failure information.

evidence_requirements.name: Operations Personnel Roles & Approvals
evidence_requirements.description: Documentation of operations personnel roles, accountability (especially handling failures or updates) and management approvals.

controls.title: AI System Recording of Event Logs
controls.description: The organization shall determine at which phases of the AI system life cycle, record keeping of event logs should be enabled, but at the minimum when the AI system is in use.
controls.full_text: The organization shall determine at which phases of the AI system life cycle, record keeping of event logs should be enabled, but at the minimum when the AI system is in use.

evidence_requirements.name: AI Event Logging Standard
evidence_requirements.description: Standard specifying logging across AI life-cycle phases (minimum: in-use), covering traceability and detection of out-of-condition performance.

evidence_requirements.name: Event Log Samples
evidence_requirements.description: Sample event logs (time/date of use, input production data, out-of-range outputs) demonstrating logging implementation.

evidence_requirements.name: Log Retention Policy
evidence_requirements.description: Retention policy aligned with intended use, organizational retention policies and applicable legal requirements (e.g., biometric identification).

controls.title: Data for Development and Enhancement of AI System
controls.description: The organization shall define, document and implement data management processes related to the development of AI systems.
controls.full_text: The organization shall define, document and implement data management processes related to the development of AI systems.

evidence_requirements.name: AI Data Management Procedure
evidence_requirements.description: Documented data management processes addressing privacy/security implications, security/safety threats arising from data-dependent AI development, transparency/explainability (including provenance), representativeness vs operational domain, accuracy and integrity of data.

evidence_requirements.name: Data Management Implementation Evidence
evidence_requirements.description: Evidence of operational implementation (e.g., data pipelines, validation jobs, access controls).

controls.title: Acquisition of Data
controls.description: The organization shall determine and document details about the acquisition and selection of the data used in AI systems.
controls.full_text: The organization shall determine and document details about the acquisition and selection of the data used in AI systems.

evidence_requirements.name: Data Acquisition Register
evidence_requirements.description: Register documenting categories of data needed, quantity, sources (internal/purchased/shared/open/synthetic), source characteristics, data subject demographics, prior handling, data rights, metadata and provenance for each AI system.

evidence_requirements.name: Data Selection Rationale Document
evidence_requirements.description: Documented rationale for data selection including suitability for intended AI task.

evidence_requirements.name: Data Sourcing Contracts / Licenses
evidence_requirements.description: Contracts and licenses for purchased/shared data including PII and copyright terms.

controls.title: Quality of Data for AI Systems
controls.description: The organization shall define and document requirements for data quality and ensure that data used to develop and operate the AI system meet those requirements.
controls.full_text: The organization shall define and document requirements for data quality and ensure that data used to develop and operate the AI system meet those requirements.

evidence_requirements.name: Data Quality Requirements Document
evidence_requirements.description: Documented data quality requirements for training, validation, test and production data (aligned with ISO/IEC 25024 / ISO/IEC 5259 series).

evidence_requirements.name: Data Quality Measurement Reports
evidence_requirements.description: Reports measuring data quality and bias against requirements, with adjustments to model/data to improve performance and fairness.

controls.title: Data Provenance
controls.description: The organization shall define and document a process for recording the provenance of data used in its AI systems over the life cycles of the data and the AI system.
controls.full_text: The organization shall define and document a process for recording the provenance of data used in its AI systems over the life cycles of the data and the AI system.

evidence_requirements.name: Data Provenance Process
evidence_requirements.description: Documented process for recording data provenance (creation, update, transcription, abstraction, validation, control transfer, sharing, transformation) per ISO 8000-2.

evidence_requirements.name: Data Provenance Records
evidence_requirements.description: Provenance records (lineage logs, transformation history) for data used in AI systems.

controls.title: Data Preparation
controls.description: The organization shall define and document its criteria for selecting data preparations and the data preparation methods to be used.
controls.full_text: The organization shall define and document its criteria for selecting data preparations and the data preparation methods to be used.

evidence_requirements.name: Data Preparation Criteria & Methods Document
evidence_requirements.description: Documented criteria and methods for data preparation (statistical exploration, cleaning, imputation, normalization, scaling, target-variable labelling, encoding) for each AI task.

evidence_requirements.name: Data Preparation Logs
evidence_requirements.description: Logs of preparation steps applied to datasets used in development and operation of AI systems.

controls.title: System Documentation and Information for Users
controls.description: The organization shall determine and provide the necessary information to users of the AI system.
controls.full_text: The organization shall determine and provide the necessary information to users of the AI system.
controls.category: Information for Interested Parties of AI Systems

evidence_requirements.name: User Documentation Pack
evidence_requirements.description: User documentation covering purpose, notification of AI interaction, how to interact/override, technical requirements/limitations/expected lifetime, human-oversight needs, accuracy/performance information, impact assessment information (including demographic context), revisions to benefit claims, updates/changes, contact information and educational materials.

evidence_requirements.name: Information Determination Criteria
evidence_requirements.description: Documented criteria for what information is provided (intended use, reasonably foreseeable misuse, user expertise, specific impact).

evidence_requirements.name: Information Validation Records
evidence_requirements.description: Records validating user access to, completeness, accuracy and currency of provided information.

controls.title: External Reporting
controls.description: The organization shall provide capabilities for interested parties to report adverse impacts of the AI system.
controls.full_text: The organization shall provide capabilities for interested parties to report adverse impacts of the AI system.
controls.category: Information for Interested Parties of AI Systems

evidence_requirements.name: External Adverse-Impact Reporting Channel
evidence_requirements.description: Documented and operational reporting channel (web form, email, hotline) for interested parties to report adverse impacts (e.g., unfairness).

evidence_requirements.name: Adverse-Impact Report Register
evidence_requirements.description: Register of received adverse-impact reports with status, investigation and resolution.

controls.title: Communication of Incidents
controls.description: The organization shall determine and document a plan for communicating incidents to users of the AI system.
controls.full_text: The organization shall determine and document a plan for communicating incidents to users of the AI system.
controls.category: Information for Interested Parties of AI Systems

evidence_requirements.name: Incident Communication Plan
evidence_requirements.description: Plan covering types of incidents to communicate, timeline for notification, authorities to notify and required details, integrated with overall incident management.

evidence_requirements.name: Incident Communication Templates
evidence_requirements.description: Templates for notifying users and other interested parties of incidents (including AI-specific and PII data breach scenarios).

evidence_requirements.name: Incident Communication Records
evidence_requirements.description: Records of incident communications executed per plan.

controls.title: Information for Interested Parties
controls.description: The organization shall determine and document their obligations to reporting information about the AI system to interested parties.
controls.full_text: The organization shall determine and document their obligations to reporting information about the AI system to interested parties.
controls.category: Information for Interested Parties of AI Systems

evidence_requirements.name: Reporting Obligations Register
evidence_requirements.description: Register of reporting obligations to authorities, customers, regulators and other interested parties, including timeframes and content (technical documentation, datasets, algorithmic justifications, V&V records, risks, AISIA results, logs).

evidence_requirements.name: Sample Reports / Notifications
evidence_requirements.description: Examples of executed reports to interested parties (regulators, customers).

evidence_requirements.name: Law Enforcement Information Handling Procedure
evidence_requirements.description: Procedure addressing jurisdictional requirements for information shared with law enforcement authorities.

controls.title: Processes for Responsible Use of AI Systems
controls.description: The organization shall define and document the processes for the responsible use of AI systems.
controls.full_text: The organization shall define and document the processes for the responsible use of AI systems.

evidence_requirements.name: Responsible AI Use Procedure
evidence_requirements.description: Documented procedure for the responsible use of AI systems including required approvals, cost, approved sourcing requirements and applicable legal requirements.

evidence_requirements.name: AI Use Approval Records
evidence_requirements.description: Approval records evidencing application of the responsible-use procedure prior to using particular AI systems.

controls.title: Objectives for Responsible Use of AI System
controls.description: The organization shall identify and document objectives to guide the responsible use of AI systems.
controls.full_text: The organization shall identify and document objectives to guide the responsible use of AI systems.

evidence_requirements.name: Responsible Use Objectives Document
evidence_requirements.description: Documented objectives (fairness, accountability, transparency, explainability, reliability, safety, robustness/redundancy, privacy/security, accessibility) for responsible AI use.

evidence_requirements.name: Human Oversight Plan
evidence_requirements.description: Plan defining where and how meaningful human oversight is incorporated in the AI system life cycle (review/override authority, monitoring, reporting of concerns, automated-decision appropriateness).

evidence_requirements.name: Human Oversight Personnel Training Records
evidence_requirements.description: Training records and instructions for personnel performing human-oversight activities related to the AI system.

controls.title: Intended Use of the AI System
controls.description: The organization shall ensure that the AI system is used according to the intended uses of the AI system and its accompanying documentation.
controls.full_text: The organization shall ensure that the AI system is used according to the intended uses of the AI system and its accompanying documentation.

evidence_requirements.name: Intended-Use Conformance Procedure
evidence_requirements.description: Procedure ensuring AI system deployment and use align with associated documentation, including required human oversight and data alignment.

evidence_requirements.name: Misuse / Concern Escalation Records
evidence_requirements.description: Records of concerns communicated to internal personnel and to third-party suppliers regarding impact or legal-requirement concerns from intended deployment.

evidence_requirements.name: Use Event Logs & Documentation
evidence_requirements.description: Event logs and other documentation demonstrating use as intended and supporting concern communication; retained per intended use and applicable legal/data-retention requirements.

controls.title: Allocating Responsibilities
controls.description: The organization shall ensure that responsibilities within their AI system life cycle are allocated between the organization, its partners, suppliers, customers and third parties.
controls.full_text: The organization shall ensure that responsibilities within their AI system life cycle are allocated between the organization, its partners, suppliers, customers and third parties.

evidence_requirements.name: AI Life-Cycle Responsibility Allocation Document
evidence_requirements.description: Document allocating AI life-cycle responsibilities between the organization, partners, suppliers, customers and third parties (including data, algorithms/models, development and use).

evidence_requirements.name: PII Controller/Processor Determination
evidence_requirements.description: Where PII is processed, determination of PII controller / joint PII controller / PII processor roles per ISO/IEC 29100 and ISO/IEC 27701.

evidence_requirements.name: AI System Documentation Delivery Records
evidence_requirements.description: Records demonstrating delivery of necessary technical/user documentation to relevant interested parties and third parties receiving the AI system.

controls.title: Suppliers
controls.description: The organization shall establish a process to ensure that its usage of services, products or materials provided by suppliers aligns with the organization's approach to the responsible development and use of AI systems.
controls.full_text: The organization shall establish a process to ensure that its usage of services, products or materials provided by suppliers aligns with the organization's approach to the responsible development and use of AI systems.

evidence_requirements.name: AI Supplier Management Procedure
evidence_requirements.description: Procedure for selecting AI suppliers (datasets, models, libraries, complete AI systems) considering supplier type and risk, with requirements, ongoing monitoring and evaluation.

evidence_requirements.name: AI Supplier Register
evidence_requirements.description: Register of AI suppliers, what they supply, integration into AI systems and risk assessments.

evidence_requirements.name: Supplier Corrective Action Records
evidence_requirements.description: Records requiring suppliers to take corrective actions when AI systems/components do not align with the organization's responsible approach.

evidence_requirements.name: Supplier-Delivered AI Documentation
evidence_requirements.description: Evidence that suppliers have delivered appropriate and adequate documentation related to supplied AI systems.

controls.title: Customers
controls.description: The organization shall ensure that its responsible approach to the development and use of AI systems considers their customer expectations and needs.
controls.full_text: The organization shall ensure that its responsible approach to the development and use of AI systems considers their customer expectations and needs.

evidence_requirements.name: Customer Requirements Capture Records
evidence_requirements.description: Records of customer expectations and needs captured during design/engineering and through contractual or general usage agreements.

evidence_requirements.name: Customer Risk Information Pack
evidence_requirements.description: Information provided to customers identifying risks of AI products/services and limits of valid domains of use, enabling customer risk treatment.

evidence_requirements.name: Responsibility Boundary Document
evidence_requirements.description: Documented allocation of responsibility between AI system provider and customer, addressing supplier/customer relationship complexity.
